mirror.reason: auto: no mirrored key in input

rig.convention: quaternions (x, y, z, w), Hamilton product, active rotation; global[j] = global[parent] * local[j]; position[j] = position[parent] + rotate(global[parent], offset[j]); pelvis at the origin; positions relative to the hip midpoint. Fit: weighted Kabsch where a joint has several children (pelvis, neck, nose), shortest arc in the parent frame where it has one, identity at the leaves; shoulders and hips add the twist about their bone that keeps their own and the elbow's or knee's rotation closest to the previous key (the first key: closest to rest).
